issue.title: Privatize FilesQueryIndexResult after artifacts pane split
issue.description: On HEAD 392dcc962, just check reaches lint (symvision) and reports FilesQueryIndexResult in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/artifacts/files_query_index.py as an unused public class. Commit c756a7c63 made the formerly-private result public during the files_pane.py split, claiming it was imported across modules, but rg shows every construction/type check remains inside files_query_index.py; only FilesQueryIndexMixin is imported by files_pane.py. This independently blocks the repository check gate alongside separately routed active-epic findings. Rename the dataclass back to a private symbol, remove it from __all__, update its in-file annotations/usages, and run focused artifacts-files tests plus just check. The reporting agent's own diff touches only src/sase/llm_provider/registry*.py.
